docs.title: Free-Form Deformation (FFD)
docs.text: This blog documents our implementation of FFD in Unity.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: We use a 3×3×3 control lattice and Bernstein polynomial weighting.

docs.title: Implementation
docs.text: Vertices are mapped into STU space and deformed using control points.

docs.title: Aim
docs.text: The aim of this project is to implement and study a Free-Form Deformation system in Unity using a 3D control lattice and Bernstein polynomial-based weighting.

docs.title: Motivation
docs.text: FFD is a fundamental geometric deformation technique used in computer graphics, modeling, and animation.

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
• Implement a 3×3×3 control lattice
  • Map mesh vertices into STU parametric space
  • Evaluate deformation using Bernstein polynomials
  • Allow real-time interaction with control points

docs.title: Methods
docs.text:
• Free-Form Deformation (Sederberg & Parry)
  • Bernstein basis functions
  • Unity C# implementation
